properties.name: Templo Mayor — Heart of Tenochtitlan
properties.description: Twin pyramid temple in the center of the Aztec capital, dedicated to Huitzilopochtli and Tlaloc. Site of mass human sacrifices.
properties.modernStatus: Archaeological site and museum in Mexico City

properties.name: Teotihuacán — City of the Gods
properties.description: Massive pre-Aztec city with the Pyramid of the Sun and Moon. The Aztecs believed the gods created the Fifth Sun here.
properties.modernStatus: UNESCO World Heritage Site, most visited ruin in Mexico
